observed_reality.path_repair: PR469 lstat-checks the regular-file leaf and every ancestor, rejects symlinks, requires root ownership and rejects group/world writable components.
observed_reality.remaining_gap: The evaluator checks paths in the observer/host namespace and does not query RootDirectory or RootImage; therefore path-component integrity is not yet evidence that the service executes the same filesystem object under an alternate service root or mount view.

primary_external_evidence.finding: RESOLVE_NO_SYMLINKS and RESOLVE_NO_XDEV are distinct controls; RESOLVE_NO_XDEV rejects traversal across mount points including bind mounts.

primary_external_evidence.source: systemd upstream documentation / D-Bus service properties
primary_external_evidence.finding: RootDirectory is a service property and alternate service-root mechanisms can change the filesystem view used by the executed process.

primary_external_evidence.source: SQLite upstream WAL documentation and release logs
primary_external_evidence.finding: WAL-reset corruption is fixed in 3.51.3 and later; 3.53.4 is in a fixed upstream release family, but release-family safety does not prove the productive mapped SQLite object or service namespace identity.

grf.generated_reality: A full root-owned non-writable no-symlink host path chain is sufficient to prove the systemd service will execute the same launcher object.
grf.counter_reality: The service may have an alternate root or mount namespace in which the same absolute ExecStart pathname resolves to a byte-distinct object while the host-side path chain still passes.
grf.falsifier: Inject a non-empty alternate service root into otherwise-admitted candidate semantics and compare candidate result while the same absolute launcher pathname resolves to distinct bytes under that root.

exactly_one_bounded_unusual_experiment_t.name: SYSTEMD_ROOTDIRECTORY_NAMESPACE_ALIAS
exactly_one_bounded_unusual_experiment_t.scope: disposable local logic-level execution of the PR469 candidate semantics with real root-owned files; no systemd service, production state or canonical Frank state mutated
exactly_one_bounded_unusual_experiment_t.interpretation: The current candidate proves host path-component policy but does not yet prove that its observed launcher object is the object visible to the service execution namespace.

integration.product_delta: No product patch applied because PR469 exact-head target run was still queued and mutating that branch would invalidate the pending acceptance observation.
integration.next_smallest_repair: Fail closed on non-empty RootDirectory/RootImage and other path-substituting namespace properties, or preferably attest the actual running service root/mount namespace plus exact mapped artifact identity.
integration.next_falsifier: Run an exact-head accepted-Ubuntu negative fixture proving alternate-root/path-substitution denial and a rescue fixture proving the intended host namespace still passes; then compose with trusted artifact authority, mapped SQLite object identity, pre-open state classification and restart/rollback controls.
